objective: The feed: GET /feed with infinite scroll on next_before_id, a Composite PostNode that renders a post and a thread uniformly at any depth, a LiveScoreTickerDecorator for posts carrying live scores, optimistic like/unlike, and reply/repost entry points into the compose unit.
acceptance_criteria: The feed renders from GET /feed and loads the next page using next_before_id from the previous response, stopping cleanly when the response reports no further page.
A guest with no token and a signed-in user render through the same feed component, and no component branches on which feed strategy the API chose.
A single PostNode component renders both a standalone post and a post with replies, at any nesting depth, without a separate thread-specific component.
GET /feed/thread/{post_id} returns root plus direct replies, and expanding a reply calls the same endpoint for that reply rather than fetching the whole thread again.
A post whose live_scores field is non-empty renders wrapped in LiveScoreTickerDecorator; a post with an empty live_scores renders unwrapped, and the decorator is not in the tree.
Liking a post updates the like state and count before the request returns, and a failure restores both.
Media renders from the public-media key joined to the configured media base URL; a media item that fails to load renders no image at all rather than a broken image element.
The reply and repost controls open the compose unit pre-seeded with the reply or repost context, and do not reimplement any part of composing.
No PinnedPostDecorator exists anywhere in the diff.
